rule: Every entry is pinned to an exact reviewed branch tip and is terminal only when current convergence preserves or strengthens the branch's valid behavior.

entries.rationale: This one-commit branch introduced exact installed Intel oneAPI provider selection, file verification, imported CMake targets, and custom-stack activation of LAPLACE_VERIFY_ONEAPI_INSTALLED_PROVIDER. Current main retains the installed-provider lock verifier and LaplaceOneApiProvider.cmake selection boundary, still enables it in the self-hosted custom-stack lane, and additionally consumes the verified provider in product package construction and provider-dependent tests. The older branch explicitly stopped before product-runtime activation, while current code carries the same verified selection forward into later package/runtime proof. Replaying the old patch would regress that stronger current provider lifecycle.

This preserved one-commit branch introduced the receipted framework producer ABI, producer control/replay checkpoints, and laplace_framework_run_producer. Current main retains the public producer API and implementation, exercises it in framework, spool, composition and Unicode-root tests, and has extended it with artifact-producing execution and live cognition-firmware/persistence consumers. Replaying the archived patch would replace a broader current producer/replay boundary with its earlier subset.

This archived two-patch branch rebased the generated machine-exception registry and wired its native tests into CTest. Current main retains the generated machine-exception contract/registry, links it as Laplace::MachineException, includes tests/machine_exception.cmake from the active test graph, executes the machine_exception_tests.cpp behavior suite, registers its evidence fragment, and additionally exposes the registry through PostgreSQL. Both historical patches are therefore represented by stronger current implementation and test registration.
